summary.content:
Today's selection covers 37 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 22 on Artificial Intelligence and 10 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: One Job That Is Growing in the A.I. Era? Cybersecurity Experts.
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: 7-Eleven data breach exposes personal information of 185,000 people
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BleepingComputer, NY Times Tech, Krebs on Security, The Verge, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 25 articles published in the last 24 hours
